jobs.description:
This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Launched in 2017, 
mozzeno is a 100% Belgian digital lender that has established itself as a key player in the credit market.
 

Every day, we help individuals and businesses finance their projects through a simple, fast and fully digital process. Our strength? A unique blend of technology and human support, allowing us to deliver an efficient and personalised service.

In parallel, we give investors the opportunity to actively support the real economy in Belgium by financing the loans granted by mozzeno.
 

Based in 
Louvain-la-Neuve and currently experiencing strong growth, mozzeno is looking for an 
AI Automation Engineer to design, orchestrate and AI-augment our business processes.
 

Job content
 

As an AI Automation Engineer, you will design, build and maintain a portfolio of automation solutions that support mozzeno's teams and business processes — increasingly powered by AI.

Concretely, you will:
 
 

• Build automations with Python and PowerShell — scripts, integrations and services that connect our applications, move and transform data, and remove manual steps across the organisation. 

• Design and ship AI-powered workflows using Dify — our AI workflow platform — to orchestrate LLM-based steps (document processing, classification, extraction, drafting, internal assistants and agents) and embed them safely into our business processes. 

• Orchestrate end-to-end processes across our tools and systems — understanding how each application delivers part of the overall solution, and building the integrations and logic that make them work together reliably from one end to the other. 

• Develop functional expertise in our solution architecture, digging into the operational reality of each process to identify pain points and formulate solutions that genuinely improve the way we work. 

• Manage and get the most out of the external tools used by our teams, keeping them current, well-integrated and delivering real value. 
 

• You have a degree in computer science, or you are self-taught with tangible IT experience. 

• You are 
proficient in Python and PowerShell for automation, scripting and integration work — comfortable working with APIs, manipulating data, and building reliable, maintainable code. 

• You have a genuine interest in 
AI and LLMs, and ideally hands-on experience building workflows with 
Dify (or similar tools such as n8n, LangChain, Make, or comparable LLM-orchestration platforms). You are familiar with concepts such as 
prompting, RAG, embeddings, agentic workflows and tool/function calling, and understand how to put an LLM to work reliably inside a business process. 

• You are comfortable 
integrating and orchestrating systems through APIs, and think naturally about how tools and processes fit together end to end. 

• You are at ease in a 
cloud environment (Google, AWS). 

• You are naturally eager to learn the big picture, to dive into the functional and operational aspects of a business process, to understand the details and pain points, and to formulate solutions to improve them. 

• You have excellent problem-solving skills and can judge when to involve peers or experts. 

• You are detail-oriented, with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and projects at once. 

• You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work with a range of stakeholders across the organisation. 

• You can work effectively in French & English, and Dutch is always an asset

You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.
You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
• +10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Position summary:
 

You are responsible for leading the plant mechanical team (Shift Mechanical Engineers, Toolroom, Utility team, Workshop Team, Process Engineers) in all the maintenance and process activities in the plant to ensure smooth operation and maintenance of high speed can making Lines and ancillaries. You will be the key person driving operational excellence programs and size changes in the plant, and also be responsible for all the mechanical safety, lean events, capital projects, energy saving, and EIP.

What are we looking for?
 
 

• 7+ years relevant experience in maintenance in high-speed manufacturing with sound maintenance management practices. 

• Experience in mechanical power presses, hydraulic equipment maintenance, printing press, handling LPG, maintenance of gas-fired ovens, boilers etc. 

• Knowledge of AutoCAD - Mechanical. 

• Experienced in TPM implementation in process industry. Good understanding of other modern lean manufacture technique - SMED, Kaizen 5S, Structured Problem Solving, Six Sigma. 

• Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 

• Ability to prioritize workload based upon the plant requirements and KPI’s. Good planning skills, coordination skill and follow-up skill 

• Comfortable communication in written and spoken English
